Title: Nova Games Summer Esports Championship announced
Summary: Company news: dates, venue and prize pool for the 2026 Nova Games Summer Esports Championship.
Answer:
The Nova Games Summer Esports Championship returns in July 2026 at the Austin Convention Center.

  • Qualifiers run online from May 4 to June 14.
  • Sixteen teams reach the finals, played July 18 to 20.
  • Tickets go on sale on April 1 through the Nova Games events page.

Follow our social channels for the full schedule and team announcements.

Title: Office closures: 2026 company holiday calendar
Summary: Internal: days the Nova Games offices are closed in 2026.
Answer:
Nova Games offices are closed on these days in 2026:

  • January 1: New Year's Day
  • May 25: Memorial Day
  • July 3: Independence Day (observed)
  • September 7: Labor Day
  • November 26 and 27: Thanksgiving
  • December 24 and 25: winter break

Regional offices follow local public holidays. Contact your office manager for details.

Title: Careers at Nova Games: how to apply
Summary: Company news: how to find open roles and apply to work at Nova Games.
Answer:
1. Browse open roles on the Nova Games careers page.
  2. Apply with your resume and, for creative roles, a portfolio link.
  3. Recruiters reply within two weeks.
  4. Interviews include a recruiter call, a skills exercise and a team interview.

Nova Games is an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Nova Games brand and logo usage guidelines
Summary: Internal: rules for using the Nova Games name, logo and colours in partner and press materials.
Answer:
• Use the full-colour logo on light backgrounds and the white logo on dark backgrounds.
  • Keep clear space around the logo equal to the height of the letter N.
  • Never stretch, recolour or add effects to the logo.
  • Primary brand colour: Nova Violet. Secondary: Midnight.

Send partner and press requests to the brand team for approval.
